title: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
visualBrief: Specific Brahma Temple Pushkar exterior: red curvilinear ribbed shikhara with stepped attached minor spires/finial, pale closed rear shrine/door behind open blue-column mandapa, two shallow red domes and red lobed parapets. Molded blue supports/original cream-gold-green petal bands, projecting blue front canopy, broad actual treads/pale cheek blocks and occupied checked platform. Map-shaped pale low entrance-side annexes retain the full temple footprint; unseen roof/door detail remains simplified. The mapped adjoining pale courtyard gallery is included as a low flat-topped envelope with original simple court arches; unseen outer rooms remain simplified. Independent market/court buildings, trees, people/festival covers/signs and furnished ritual interior are not authored.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Named PMTilesbuilding/templePOI35184810382324 (encoded OSMway438293492) covers the temple main body and eastern appendages near retainedQ4955510 reference74.54887778,26.48732778. Independent named node17599792637901 lies within the main body. Measured long edge gives ENE axis-0.2644885496056613rad; anchor is original reference, heading0/native east-south. The eastern mapped appendages/approach and pictured shrine-behind-open-hall relationship support an approximate east-facing portico. Internal tower/dome/support/door layout, front/back sign and annex allocation remain picture/map estimates, retaining roughly5m/30degree facing uncertainty rather than a surveyed plan. Adjoining wrapping footprint35184809402181 is included as the pictured low pale courtyard gallery after generic multi-storey procedural extrusion obscured the hall during construction inspection. Its temple-complex association, outer room inventory and low roof height are approximate photo/topology allocations; all other buildings stay independent.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Picture/map estimates: occupied hall platform1.05m above the local court floor; molded blue supports5.2m/canopy5.6m, red lobed parapets about6.7m/two shallow domes about8m; curvilinear red shikhara from5.8m to17.4m, gold crown/finial and static flag to19.4m. Pale rear shrine about8x13m, mandapa about17x14.6m plus projecting front canopy, main body/annex envelope follows the mapped40x25m shape. Exact hidden support/room inventory, subsidiary spires, original painted ornament and current paint/roof state are simplified exterior estimates from dated2006/2007 pictures.
